summary: OpenAI announced commitments to support the U.S. Department of Energy's Genesis Mission, providing National Laboratory and university researchers with Codex access, API credits, bioscience and cybersecurity model access, and early access to new models and features.

mechanisms.reason: The announcement commits specific dollar amounts of expanded API and Codex usage to thousands of researchers, increasing aggregate token consumption on OpenAI's models.
mechanisms.quote: Offer participating researchers up to $10 million in API usage for $2.5 million spent, expanding the work Genesis researchers can support.

practices.reason: OpenAI describes internal evaluation work on safe multimodal AI use in lab settings, but the method is lab-specific and not directly transferable to an outside engineering team.
practices.quote: OpenAI and Los Alamos developed evaluations to study how multimodal AI systems can be used safely by scientists in realistic laboratory environments.
